review_kind: independent criterion-based review of six selected adapted forward smoke trials
rubric_hash_method: SHA-256 of the selected case rubric array serialized with json.dumps(rubric, separators=(",", ":")), preserving array/object order; run-input source_rubric_sha256 is not a whole cases.json file hash.

scoring.critical_failure_rule: Any critical criterion scored fail (0) makes its trial unsuccessful regardless of total; all criteria here passed.
scoring.aggregation: Unweighted criterion sum across only these selected cases.

limitations: Adapted smoke trials; not runner-compliant corpus evaluations.
Web and delegation capabilities remained available and were restricted by instructions rather than enforced runner tool allowlists.
tools.md is an explicit agent self-report, not a host-exported or independently audited execution trace. It cannot prove complete tool use or instruction compliance.

This review scores actual saved answers against selected source rubrics, verifies current snapshot integrity, and independently checks arithmetic/local ring behavior. It does not verify production performance or deployment behavior.
Snapshot hash equality establishes final-state integrity; it cannot prove the absence of transient writes during the original trials.
No original-versus-revised comparison exists; no improvement or causal skill-revision claim is supported.
Only one selected case per skill was exercised. Results do not cover nontrigger or remaining corpus cases.
